missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Сосед' is in the nominative as the subject. 'Мой' agrees in masculine nominative, and 'добрый' is the predicate adjective describing him.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Соседа' is animate masculine, so its accusative copies the genitive form. 'Своего' agrees, and 'давно' marks the long acquaintance.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Соседа' is genitive after 'у' to mark whose dog it is. 'Большая собака' is the nominative subject of the possession frame.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Соседу' is the dative object of 'помогаю', the one helped. 'Своему' agrees in masculine dative. 'Помогать' always governs the dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a verb. 'Соседом' is instrumental because 'познакомиться с' governs that case. 'Новым' agrees in masculine instrumental. The standard way to say you met someone.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О соседе' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Нашем' agrees in masculine prepositional, naming the neighbour discussed.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Соседи' is the irregular soft nominative plural acting as the subject. 'Наши' agrees, and 'шумные' is the predicate adjective in the plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate plural. 'Соседей' is the irregular animate plural, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Всех' agrees in the same form. Useful for invitations.
Strategic focus: Dative plural with direction. 'Соседям' is the dative plural after 'к' to express going to someone's place. 'Часто' marks how regularly the visits happen.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Соседей' is the irregular genitive plural because 'много' governs that case. 'В нашем доме' sets the location.
